decisions.statement: The handoff environment is read once and then deleted from the process environment.
An inherited Claude settles the process id and account and agent id and session id.
An agent id is created only where neither the handoff nor the options have an agent id.
A session id absent from both the handoff and the options is a fresh uuid.
Headless states the launch as spawned and interactive states that launch as opened.
The console is redirected to the agent before any credential work begins.
Nothing here spawns a Claude child.
This module readies the setup a child will need.
A stating that never returns holds boot open rather than being cut at a ceiling.

definition: the once-per-run setup of a seat's account, agent id, proxy and monitors
